milestone: known-bad fixture: a negative control that does not fail must stop the write probe

capabilities.name: control that writes instead of failing
capabilities.excludes: everything else in the scratch dir
capabilities.remedy: make the control omit a required field so it is refused before anything is created

negative_control.why: stands in for an invalid value the server accepted: it writes and exits 0. It also exits non-zero if the write probe already ran, so a script that runs the write first passes this control and fails the fixture
